body.name: Smooth signed two-fiber CATE family
body.construction: Let \(F_\lambda=\zeta_h\sum_{j=1}^k\lambda_j\psi_j\), \(K_h=\mathbb E_\lambda F_\lambda^2=\zeta_h^2\), and \(D_{\mathrm{fuz}}=1/4-a^2K_h\). Define \(\pi_\lambda=1/2+aF_\lambda\), \(m_{s,\lambda}=1/2+sbF_\lambda\), \(\tau_s=-sabK_h/D_{\mathrm{fuz}}\), \(\mu_{0,s,\lambda}=m_{s,\lambda}-\pi_\lambda\tau_s\), and \(\mu_{1,s,\lambda}=m_{s,\lambda}+(1-\pi_\lambda)\tau_s\). Under \(P_{s,\lambda}\), draw \(X\) uniformly, draw independent binary potential outcomes conditional on \(X\) with means \(\mu_{0,s,\lambda}(X)\) and \(\mu_{1,s,\lambda}(X)\), draw \(A\mid X\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\pi_\lambda(X))\) independently of the potential outcomes, and set \(Y=AY_1+(1-A)Y_0\).
